headword: {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}
gloss: overseas travel; international travel; trip abroad

definitions.gloss: overseas travel; international travel; trip abroad
definitions.explanation: Travel to a foreign country, as opposed to domestic travel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}した→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was nervous on my first overseas trip.

examples.japanese: {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: You need a passport for overseas travel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the weak yen, the cost of overseas travel has become higher than before.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧ (overseas) + ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (travel). One of the most commonly used travel-related compounds in Japanese. Frequently appears in travel agency advertising, insurance products, and everyday conversation about vacation plans.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ — go on an overseas trip
- {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}{保険|ほけん} — overseas travel insurance
- {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ — like traveling abroad
- {海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧ — preparation for overseas travel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{国内旅行|こくないりょこう}→国内旅行：24242_kokunairyokou⟧ — domestic travel; the counterpart for travel within Japan
- ⟦{渡航|とこう}→渡航：17919_tokou⟧ — traveling abroad; more formal and administrative, used in official contexts like visa applications
- {外遊|がいゆう} — foreign tour; a formal term, often used for official or diplomatic trips abroad
